source.title: Gwyneth - Dragonslayer Knight
source.name: Gwyneth
source.description: A master of the greatbow, this Marksman fires devastating arrows that punch straight through enemy defenses.

skills.name: Hailing Arrows

description.raw: Passive. After charging up for a longer time, Gwyneth's normal attack fires an arrow that deals 360% (ATK-based) damage. Every point of ATK SPD or Haste further increases her normal attack damage by 0.1%. Active. Gwyneth selects a tile and rains arrows over it and all tiles within 2 tiles. Enemies on each affected tile take 270% (ATK-based) + 35% (SP-based) damage and become immobilized for 2s. For each wave of arrows, subsequent hits on the same target deal 80% less damage. This skill prioritizes the area with the most enemies.

skills.name: Fulgur Arrow

description.raw: Passive. Gwyneth's normal attacks follow a 3-attack cycle. Every 3rd attack is imbued with the power of lightning, silencing the target for 1s, dealing 220% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based) lightning splash damage to all enemies within 2 tiles of the target, and stunning affected enemies for 0.5s.

skills.name: Flare Arrow

description.raw: The 2nd attack in Gwyneth's normal attack cycle is imbued with the power of fire. It deals 490% (ATK-based) damage and burns the target, causing them to take 20% (ATK-based) + 2% (SP-based) damage every 0.25s for 4s. While burned, the target has their Vitality reduced by 40. This effect cannot stack.

skills.name: Fulgur Flare

description.raw: Gwyneth's normal attack damage is increased by 20%. The 1st attack in her normal attack cycle is imbued with the power of both lightning and fire, and it burns enemies hit by the lightning splash.

text: Unlocks at Exclusive Equipment Level 5: Increases Gwyneth's normal attack damage by 25%.
Unlocks at Exclusive Equipment Level 10: When an arrow is imbued with the power of both lightning and fire, it also deals extra damage to the main target equal to 10% of their max HP.
This extra damage cannot exceed 360% of Gwyneth's ATK.
All damage dealt by this arrow also ignores 60% of enemies' Phys DEF damage reduction, and 4% of all other damage taken reduction effects.
In non-boss battles, this second value is increased to 12%.
Unlocks at Exclusive Equipment Level 15: Increases Gwyneth's normal attack damage by 30%.
